visualCharacteristics.purpose: static rendering of the interactive retirement expense calculator: heading, step indicator, inputs and buttons, or just the launch button on calculator landing pages

contentPattern.structure: content rows (heading, intro, results header, launch link) and an optional ordered list for the step indicator (bold item = current step), plus field rows `label | type | options/help` for the inputs

reuseGuidance: Use for the calculator tool pages. The calculation itself is not reproduced; submitting shows a notice.
decisions: The calculator is a server-backed app; inputs render statically and submit is blocked.
